Privacy

This version of the studio has no account system, contact form, advertising scripts, or analytics added by the studio. It does not ask you to submit personal information to download a drawing.

Hosting and requests

Like other websites, the hosting service may process technical request data, such as IP addresses and browser information, to deliver and secure the website. A private preview may require sign-in handled by the hosting platform.

Files and external services

PDF downloads are served directly from the website. No externally hosted fonts or social media embeds are used. This information will need updating if additional services are introduced.
